Hi everyone,

as a science fiction fan, I am interested in SciFi that originated outside of the West, and in particular from the Eastern Bloc - that would be the communist states behind the 'iron curtain' during the Cold War, including of course the USSR. These works arose from authors living in eastern european nations, with a different culture, different government and different economic system than those in North America. In turn these eastern european nations were harmed heavily by WWII, and forcibly ruled by a police state, which likewise imposed censorship and restrictions on what could be published, while the artists nevertheless strove to express themselves as best they could. In turn, few of these works made it into english and even if so, were relatively obscure. This makes the sci-fi arising from this environment certainly different from what you'd find authored in the West during the same time period.

As for myself, I hope to read through a number of books and post spoiler-friendly book reports. I also will link to other book reports from other websites. Feel free to contribute.
